evidence.locator: PDF pages 1–3, taxonomy, ecology and fishery sections
evidence.supports: IMARPE documents a large pelagic jellyfish from Peru to southern Chile. Retain Macrozooplankton as a Very low macroscopic plankton analogue: the source defines euphausiids, whereas jellyfish differ in size, gelatinous composition and diet. Benthic polyps do not establish a caught-mass stage split. One group, no split.
